decisions.reason: The source also changes this Requirement, but its complete same-message MODIFY already records orientation selection by connector cleanliness, enclosure adaptation, and removal of the superseded orientation constraint.
The source concerns the integrated board discussed immediately beforehand, not the earlier modular power-board orientation and connector constraints.
Allowing the integrated board orientation to follow its connector layout does not change the modular power board's battery-connector placement, clearance, orientation, or spacing.
The source grants orientation freedom for the integrated board and does not revise the separate modular main board's established vertical mounting or connector-placement rules.
The source addresses the integrated board, not the separate sensor board's vertical mounting and connector-access layout.
Enclosure adaptation to the integrated board orientation does not alter the requested panel-mounted power button, connector, signal connection, or control behavior.
The source concerns physical orientation of the integrated board and does not change any modular interboard connector type, pinout, topology, or matching requirement.
The retrieval overlap is incidental; board orientation and enclosure adaptation do not change the manufacturer-order assistance obligations.
The mechanical orientation decision has no entailed effect on the AXP2101 battery, USB, charging, or rail topology requirements.
Selecting orientation by connector-layout cleanliness does not change the integrated board's component cost or sourceability policy.
The source does not revise the separate sensor board's module connector inventory, pinouts, or connector count.
The integrated board's orientation and connector layout do not entail any change to I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or cable assumptions.
